title: Countertop Soap Dispenser 5-Ounce Solid Brass Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bathroom counter with a space-saving soap dispenser featuring a generous 5 ounce bottle and solid brass construction. Designed for soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer, it adds coordinated style to vanities and sink areas in the Waverly Place collection.

Highlights:
- Countertop vanity-top dispenser helps keep soap within easy reach
- Holds soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer in a 5 ounce capacity bottle
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use
- Traditional design with classic elements for versatile bath accessories
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes to coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware

Specs:
- Collection: Waverly Place
- Mounting type: Countertop
- Material: Brass
- Overall size: 3 in L x 5 in W x 7 in H (projection 4 in)
- Weight: 2.4 lb
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Soap dispenser
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
